participation.context: Measured the loaf, kept the firing off the slate, and took the threepence in the eating.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Ate, and did not tell her about Sunday.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Laid the short loaf, and had not brought a second bough.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Went to his own work under his own name.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: the board is threepence and the loaf is a penny

story.body: You paid threepence by eating. You did not move the firing sixpence onto the slate, and you did not ask for a second bough. You gave the table no news of Sunday.

relations.note: the board is threepence and the loaf is a penny

title: Ate the board and did not mention Sunday
